metadata.question: Were the water levels in Lake Kariba in December, 2019 higher than the water levels seen in December, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: Lake Kariba is a large reservoir between Zambia and Zimbabwe. To assess water levels, I'll use Landsat 8 surface reflectance data (bands 4 and 5 for NDWI or simple water detection). I'll compare December 2018 vs December 2019 using the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) or water surface area as a proxy for water level. 2. **Masking Strategy**: I'll use cloud masking (QA_PIXEL band) to ensure quality pixels. Water is typically NDWI > 0.3, so I'll filter for valid water pixels. 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Error**: - If no images found in either December (after filtering), output C1. - If images exist but all pixels are masked (count = 0), output C2. - If NDWI calculation returns NaN or invalid values, output C3. - If mean NDWI(2019) > mean NDWI(2018), answer is A (higher water levels). - If mean NDWI(2019) <= mean NDWI(2018), answer is B (not higher). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Lake Kariba boundaries (approximate center and region) const lakeKariba = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([25.5, -18.5, 29.0, -15.5]); // Define time periods: December 2018 and December 2019 const dec2018Start = '2018-12-01'; const dec2018End = '2018-12-31'; const dec2019Start = '2019-12-01'; const dec2019End = '2019-12-31'; // Function to calculate NDWI and filter for valid pixels function processDecember(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeKariba) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(img) { // Cloud masking using QA_PIXEL const qaMask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0); // Select bands: B5 (NIR), B4 (Red) const nir = img.select('SR_B5'); const red = img.select('SR_B4'); // Calculate NDWI: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) const ndwi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDWI'); return ndwi.updateMask(qaMask); }); } // Retrieve collections const col2018 = processDecember(dec2018Start, dec2018End); const col2019 = processDecember(dec2019Start, dec2019End); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2018 Images: ${size2018}`); console.log(`Dec 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); // Check for empty collections if (size2018 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both December periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Merge images and calculate median NDWI const median2018 = col2018.median(); const median2019 = col2019.median(); // Check pixel counts (valid pixels after masking) const count2018 = median2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const count2019 = median2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2018 Valid Pixels: ${count2018}`); console.log(`Dec 2019 Valid Pixels: ${count2019}`); if (count2018 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NDWI for water bodies (proxy for water level) const mean2018 = median2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const mean2019 = median2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2018 Mean NDWI: ${(mean2018 || 0).toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Dec 2019 Mean NDWI: ${(mean2019 || 0).toFixed(4)}`); // Validation: check for NaN or invalid results if (mean2018 === null || mean2018 === undefined || isNaN(mean2018) || mean2019 === null || mean2019 === undefined || isNaN(mean2019)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare water levels if (mean2019 > mean2018) { console.log('Water levels (NDWI) higher in Dec 2019 than Dec 2018.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water levels (NDWI) not higher in Dec 2019 than Dec 2018.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
